$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFRM (AIP France, chart dated 2026-02-19): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Le Mans-Arnage

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.
Possible IFR operations.
Restrictions during motor race ‘'24 heures du Mans'' and others events "Le Mans Classic", "MOTO GP" (issued by NOTAM).etc.
RWY 02 and 20 prohibited if crosswind higher than: 20 kt on wet RWY,; 25 kt on dry RWY.
North apron unavailable, except for the "24 Hours of Le Mans" event.
Noise-sensitive AD: RWY patterns prohibited for non home based ACFT between 2100 and 0700 UTC (SUM: - 1 HR).
The use of the RWY is permitted at night only if the PAPI are in use.
By night only TWY A is available.
Preferred QFU 019° due to IFR procedure.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.

"Low height" circuits only for training flights with instructor and forbidden the WE and public holidays from 01st April to 31st October between 1100-1300 UTC (SUM: -1HR) and between 1800-SS UTC (SUM: -1HR): MNM 500 ft AAL East of RWY 02/20.
Avoid overflying Le Mans, Arnage and gasplant Butagaz located 2500 m from ARP QDR 200°.
RVR < 800 m: lighting and runway guard lights switched on, TWY A available only.
After TKOF runway 02, route alteration by 30° right as soon as possible.
PAPI 20: MEHT adapted to CAT A ACFT only.

Gliders' winching activity (NR 887): see AIP ENR 5.5 Parachuting (NR 220): see AIP ENR 5.5 AEM (NR 8390): see AIP ENR 5.5 Péril animalier / Wildlife strike hazard: Adapted: unavailable outside AFIS SKED or extensions.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Utilisation simultanée des deux pistes interdite.
Activité IFR possible.
Restriction à l'occasion de l'épreuve automobile des "24 heures du Mans" et autres épreuves "Le Mans Classic", GP MOTO (annoncées par NOTAM) .etc.
RWY 02 et 20 interdites par vent traversier supérieur à : 20 kt sur piste mouillée ; 25 kt sur piste sèche.
PRKG Nord inaccessible sauf à l'occasion de l'épreuve des "24 Heures du Mans".
AD sensible au bruit : tours de piste interdits aux non basés entre 2100 et 0700 UTC (ETE : - 1 HR).
L'utilisation des pistes est autorisée de nuit uniquement si les PAPI sont en fonctionnement.
De nuit seul le TWY A est utilisable.
QFU préférentiel 019° cause procédure IFR.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.

Circuits "basse hauteur" autorisés dans le cadre des vols d'entraînement avec instructeur uniquement et interdits les WE et jours fériés du 1er avril au 31 octobre entre 1100-1300 UTC (ETE : -1HR) et entre 1800-SS UTC (ETE : -1HR) : minimum 500 ft AAL à l'Est de la piste 02/20.
Éviter le survol du Mans, Arnage, et du centre Butagaz situé à 2500 m de l'ARP dans le QDR 200°.
RVR < 800 m : balisage et feux de protection de piste allumés, seul le TWY A est utilisable.
Après TKOF piste 02, altération de route 30° droite dès que possible.
PAPI 20 : MEHT appropriée pour les avions de CAT A seulement.
